ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all Gies majors on Monday, November 18, 2024. This section will open to all of campus to allow students pursuing the Entrepreneurship Certificate on Monday, November 25, 2024 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 24, 2025 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
